sources.title: Chronos-Bolt (Tiny) — TSFM.ai
sources.snippet: Chronos-Bolt Tiny is the smallest checkpoint in Amazon's Chronos-Bolt family, at 9M parameters. It is the cost and latency floor of the line: a probabilistic zero-shot forecaster small enough to favor throughput and price over peak accuracy, aimed squarely at latency-sensitive and high-volume work.

sources.title: Chronos-Bolt (Mini) — TSFM.ai
sources.snippet: Chronos-Bolt Mini is a compact 21M-parameter checkpoint in Amazon's Chronos-Bolt family. It sits one rung above Chronos-Bolt Tiny, trading a little extra capacity for a better accuracy-latency balance on moderate-volume forecasting workloads while staying firmly in the cost-efficient tier of the line.

sources.title: Chronos — Foundation Models for Time Series
sources.snippet: Chronos is a family of pretrained models for time-series forecasting. Across the original T5 Chronos, the faster Bolt variants, and the Chronos-2 generation, the family has now crossed a billion cumulative downloads on Hugging Face.
